title: Handoff
description: Schema for the agent handoff document. Provides a structured summary for human reviewers covering all artefacts produced, decisions requiring human input, suggested next steps, validation and standards summaries, traceability chains, and evidence pack location.

handoff_id.description: Unique identifier for this handoff document.

request_id.description: Identifier of the originating request this handoff relates to.

status.description: Overall status of the work being handed off.

produced_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this handoff document was produced.

produced_by.description: Identity of the agent or person that produced this handoff.

artefact_inventory.description: Inventory of all artefacts produced and included in this handoff.

path.description: File path or URI of the artefact.

schema_valid.description: Indicates whether this artefact was validated against its schema successfully.

human_decisions_required.description: Decisions that must be made by a human before the work can proceed further.

decision.description: Description of the decision that must be made.

owner.description: Role or individual responsible for making this decision.

severity.description: Severity level if this decision is not made (e.g. informational, material, hand_off_required, unsafe_to_proceed).

context.description: Contextual information to help the decision maker.

suggested_next_steps.description: Recommended follow-on actions for the human reviewer or downstream team.

step.description: Description of the recommended next step.

suggested_recipient.description: Role or team suggested to perform this step.

validation_summary.description: Aggregated summary of validation check outcomes across all artefacts.

total.description: Total number of validation checks performed.

passed.description: Number of validation checks that passed.

warned.description: Number of validation checks that passed with warnings.

failed.description: Number of validation checks that failed.

blocked.description: Number of validation checks that resulted in a blocked status.

standards_summary.description: Summary of standards coverage across all artefacts in this handoff.

missing.description: Standards that should have been applied but could not be found or accessed.

stale.description: Standards that were applied but are known to be expired or superseded.

placeholder.description: Standards referenced as placeholders where the authoritative source was not accessible.

traceability.description: End-to-end traceability chains linking requirements through to evidence.

requirement_to_mapping.description: Description or reference path showing traceability from requirements to mapping artefacts.

mapping_to_model.description: Description or reference path showing traceability from mapping artefacts to data models.

model_to_code.description: Description or reference path showing traceability from data models to generated code or DDL.

code_to_test.description: Description or reference path showing traceability from code artefacts to test definitions.

test_to_evidence.description: Description or reference path showing traceability from test results to evidence records.

unresolved_unknowns_count.description: Total number of unknowns that remain unresolved at the time of handoff.

evidence_pack_path.description: File path or URI to the bundled evidence pack for this handoff.
